name: Changa
summary: Changa is the name given to a smoking blend of Banisteriopsis caapi or other MAOI containing plants with an infusion of extracted DMT. Changa often contains other milder psychoactive herbs as well. The MAOI action results in a longer and more intense trip (see Ayahuasca) NOTE: There is no standardized recipe or concentration of infused DMT, therefore dosage and potency will vary per batch.
advisory: Combining with any medications or substance contraindicated with MAOI's particuarly SSRI's, MDxx compounds and Amphetamines. Refer to http://wiki.tripsit.me/wiki/Drug_combinations for more information.
doseBasis: NOTE: These are tentative estimates as Changa potency and dosing will vary per batch/source.
